At most 2 scans a day. Each scan reads only the e-mails that arrived since the last one, so two scans do not read more mail; a project only costs one more AI reading when it gets new e-mail both before and after the second scan. An e-mail a colleague's scan already sent to AI is not read again. Each scan reads at most {} projects with AI; the rest wait for the next scan.
